that used to need an analyst, built in: what drives sales, executive reports written for you, every promised callback tracked, a library of your best calls, and customer value and churn with save offers on the desk.

What drives results: Conversation analytics now shows, per campaign, how often a conversation ends in a sale when the agent asks discovery questions, matches the offer to the need, confirms understanding and uses the script's key lines, against when they do not. Conversion by script and the objections agents overcome are reported too, and a new source, Behaviours and sales, is in the report builder.

Outcomes to check: conversations whose recorded outcome the customer's own words contradict, such as a sale where the customer declined, are listed with the quote for a supervisor to confirm or correct. A correction updates the reports and is kept in the audit trail.

Executive insights: Reports, Executive insights writes a campaign's report for the period you choose, with the key findings, the figures behind them compared with the period before, masked quotes from conversations as evidence, and recommendations. A one-page summary prints or saves as a PDF. Every version is kept.

Callback recovery: every callback promised to a customer is tracked to the end, whether it was kept on time, late or missed, and how many turned into a sale. The Callback recovery report shows this by agent, team, campaign, queue, day or source; the Floor lists missed callbacks whose customer is still waiting, to reschedule or reassign; and an alert can warn when an agent misses too many in a day. Each campaign sets how many minutes late still counts as on time.

Call library: Quality, Call library keeps your best conversations, with why they are good and the moments to listen to. Calls with top quality scores, sales and happy customers are suggested for you to add. Agents find the library in the Academy, and a coaching assignment can point to a call in it. Customer details stay masked.

Customer value and churn: each customer has a value and a churn risk, with the reasons behind it, on their record and on the agent's desk, and both can be used in lists, filters and call-flow priority. Save offers matched to a customer's value appear on the desk when a customer at risk calls or asks to cancel, and the agent records whether the customer stayed. Customers, Retention builds upgrade, save and win-back lists for your campaigns and reports saves, value kept and churn by reason.

Live quality score: calls covered by agent assist are scored against your quality form while they happen. Must-say lines tick off as they are said, with no AI needed, and Yaxxa AI judges the rest every minute or so within your daily cap. The agent can see a checklist of what is still to say, the Floor shows each call's live score, and alerts warn a supervisor when a must-say line is missed, a score falls below the pass mark or a customer is getting upset, with Listen and Whisper one click away. Choose the form per campaign or queue under Agent assist settings; after the call, the usual quality score stays the record, with the live score beside it.

Still on break?: an agent who starts working while still on a break, by replying to a ticket or a chat or taking on work, or whose break runs past its length, is asked whether to go back to Available or stay on the break. Nothing changes until they choose, so workforce figures stay right and calls and tickets reach them again. Supervisors see on the Floor who is working on a break or has overrun it, and an alert can warn about it. Mark which reasons count as a break under Outcomes and reasons, and set the reminder in Workforce settings.

Fixes: starting a consult straight after one that failed no longer cuts the agent off and sends the customer to the colleague; a call is no longer marked failed while the call server it is on cannot be reached; and the recovery drill keeps storage keys out of view."}
